timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only serial Claude CLI stream; semantic actions were accounted but projected from the raw serial agent log.
Serial agent trajectory: probed the executable, generated Unicode/helper tables, wrote partial ESM library modules, and timed out before creating test16.mjs.

parallel.requirements: The same prompt required a Node.js ESM port of markdown/test16.py, manual parsing of --a through --e, no external dependencies, library files in /output, and final test16.mjs.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent created probe, implementation, and verification tasks, but then emphasized a broad workflow to reverse-engineer Python-Markdown behavior across many areas.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote probing/diff utilities and ran foundational probe batches; child agents produced research specs for selected Markdown areas, not a complete implementation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No implementation was assembled or delivered: artifact validation copied successfully but found an empty file list and no expected entry file.
parallel.verification: The run performed black-box probes and intended verification, but no integrated Node entry was available for meaningful whole-task verification before the official evaluator.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with the broad workflow killed, no test16.mjs, no library artifact, and an official completed score of 0/70.

serial.requirements: The serial control saw the same Markdown conversion and ESM output requirements, including exact stdout matching and manual argv parsing.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflows disabled, one agent probed behavior and incrementally wrote local ESM modules for utilities, preprocessing, HTML handling, tree serialization, and block processing.
serial.implementation: Serial created a partial library tree under lib, including constants, escaping, Unicode tables, preprocessors, HTML parser, serializer, and blockprocessor modules.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The local module tree was copied as an artifact, but no test16.mjs entry point or complete parser wiring was delivered.
serial.verification: Serial performed exploratory probes against the executable, but the official evaluator still found no valid entry deliverable and scored 0/70.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run timed out with partial modules only, missing test16.mjs and any complete executable integration.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent had the same prompt requirements: pure Node ESM, manual argv parsing, no external dependencies, library files in /output, and final test16.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had the identical task statement and recognized the need to emulate Python Markdown behavior and deliver ESM output files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement-text difference; the later difference is process and delivery, with parallel producing no artifact and serial producing partial libraries only.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into parent-created probe, implement, and verify work, then launched a 16-area behavior workflow with many child agents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran with workflow and delegation tools disabled and proceeded as a single actor without child logs or delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel allocated capacity to many probing children before implementation; serial kept ownership local and spent time writing modules directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed research specifications for Markdown behavior areas, including tool use and probe budgets, not component implementation contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-interface boundary; it maintained context inside one agent while constructing a local module tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The contrast is not missing child context or interface conflict; it is that parallel context was routed into broad research rather than deliverable construction.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel built probe/diff tooling and gathered research outputs but did not create implementation source in the final artifact directory.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote helper, preprocessing, HTML, tree, and blockprocessor modules under lib, but did not finish the parser/entry point.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial made concrete implementation progress; parallel remained research-heavy and delivered no files at artifact validation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow state ended killed with no aggregate result; only a few area specs completed while many children remained in progress or retry states.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no subagent result lifecycle; its local writes appeared directly in the copied artifact list as partial modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel research results did not transition into implementation or assembly; serial local work did not require child joining but still missed final delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact validation copied successfully but found an empty file list and no expected entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation copied a partial lib tree with 16 module files, but still lacked the expected test16.mjs entry point.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had no final tree to integrate; serial had a partial implementation tree but no executable assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The official evaluator completed and reported 0/70 with solution_passed false after the missing artifact condition.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The official evaluator also completed and reported 0/70 with solution_passed false because the entry point was missing despite partial libraries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed acceptance equally; the evaluator outcome is not discordant, but the implementation state entering evaluation differed materially.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after heavy child usage: 35 subagents, 2,629,215 workflow child tokens, and 593 workflow child tool calls.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but with zero workflow child tokens and a single-agent partial implementation path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel-specific closure pressure was broad child fan-out consuming the finite budget before deliverable creation; serial closure pressure was ordinary single-agent unfinished implementation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both parallel and serial completed evaluation and failed 0/70. The concrete difference is artifact state and process: parallel spent the run on broad multi-agent Markdown behavior research and delivered no files, while serial used a single-agent implementation path that produced partial library modules but still missed the required test16.mjs.
parallel_contributors: Parallel fan-out assigned many children to Markdown probing/refinement before deliverable implementation or assembly.
The workflow consumed large child-token/tool budgets and ended killed, leaving the artifact directory empty.
serial_contributors: Serial had workflows disabled and made direct partial implementation progress in lib modules.
Serial still timed out before writing the entry point and complete integration, so it also failed acceptance.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's failure includes ordinary unfinished implementation: partial modules but no executable entry point.
Parallel's failure includes lack of delivered implementation, but the retained taxonomy label only covers the observable coordination fan-out that displaced deliverable work.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern explains a parallel-side adverse process consequence, not a discordant official result

candidates.reason: Rejected: the parent explicitly created an implementation task and remained an owner; the adverse event was that broad probe fan-out consumed the window before implementation could matter.
Rejected: the parallel run did not produce multiple completed implementation components needing reconciliation, so there was no concrete unowned integration object.
Rejected: the required entry point was absent because the run stayed in research fan-out, not because completed components lacked an assembler.
Rejected: the parent/orchestrator owned the end-to-end attempt and launched probe, implement, and verify work; the pipeline failed through allocation and budget exhaustion.
Rejected: no single mandatory preflight or harness gate blocked productive work; the observed allocation was many simultaneous behavior probes and refinements.
Rejected as nearest match: investigators overlapped and the investigation phase never completed before implementation; the direct boundary is collective fan-out budget exhaustion.
Rejected: implementation and delivery were starved, but the more specific cause was the deliberately broad 16-area fan-out plus refinement and retries.
Retained: the workflow fanned out across 16 behavior areas and refinement probes with explicit large probe budgets; status then showed 35 child logs and no output artifact.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel run spent the finite window on broad research fan-out and ended with an empty artifact directory instead of the required test16.mjs entry point.
candidates.near_match_reason: The work did not complete a separate investigation phase before implementation; the workflow remained in probe/refine fan-out when the run ended.

candidates.reason: Rejected: no single child assignment is the dominant overbroad unit; the pressure comes from the collective breadth and retrying of many probing children.
Rejected: the children were research probes with detailed briefs; no known delivery requirement omission in one child caused a usable implementation to be missing.
Rejected: the parallel run did not delegate separately owned implementation components that later proved incompatible at an interface.
Rejected: there is no evidence that a known finding or requirement disappeared during transfer and caused repeated or wrong downstream work.
Rejected: a few research specs completed, but the workflow was killed before a parent decision window where excessive returned information was the blocker.
Rejected: no receiver consumed superseded information about requirements or workspace state.
Rejected: no incompatible child reports or contracts reached the parent and remained unadjudicated at integration time.
Rejected: the parent did not accept or present the whole task as complete; there was no submitted global completion decision.
Rejected: workflow stalls caused retries, but the evidence does not show a replacement repeating required deliverable work because inherited checkpoint state was absent.

candidates.reason: Rejected: interrupted children are downstream of the same timeout/fan-out chain; the direct corrective boundary is the excessive breadth before deliverable work.
Rejected: no complete candidate or mutually compatible component set existed that could simply have been promoted to test16.mjs.
Rejected: there was no integrated verification followed by a later merge of child work.
Rejected: no delegated implementation completed or became retrievable for the parent to join into the final solution.
Rejected: no concrete verifier finding was produced and trapped below the parent; verifier absence was downstream of the fan-out timeout.
Rejected: although many probe children stalled or were interrupted, the unfinished work was the same broad research fan-out chain rather than one required failed child needing takeover.
Rejected: completed specs such as list/code-span/nesting research were partial research outputs, not a completed implementation result ignored at a parent decision point.
Rejected: the parent and workflow were actively launching/probing rather than merely waiting without inspecting available actionable progress.
Rejected: no concurrent parallel implementation files claimed overlapping behavior and required reconciliation.
Rejected: no two live agents edited the same source file with a required reconciliation event.
Rejected: no agent replaced source produced or actively owned by another agent.
Rejected: the required deliverable test16.mjs was never produced, so it could not be overwritten.
Rejected: no cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced another actor's final-tree work.
Rejected: children wrote probe files under a shared workspace, but no concrete unstable-state or provenance consequence is evidenced.
Rejected: no generated probe file, cache, or temporary artifact was consumed as a stable reference in a way that contaminated the delivered solution.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel workflow allocated work across 16 Markdown behavior areas and refinement probes with explicit large per-child probe budgets, then consumed the run in child activity before implementation, assembly, or test16.mjs delivery happened.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel run ended with an empty artifact directory and no required test16.mjs because broad research fan-out displaced deliverable implementation and final assembly.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The investigation was not a completed first phase followed by late implementation; it was still broad active probe/refine fan-out when the run closed.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Critical-Path Starvation, Oversized Child Task, Early Child Termination, No Failure Takeover, Missing Verifier Return, and Blind Timeout Wait were reviewed as the same fan-out timeout chain and rejected in favor of Fan-out Budget Exhaustion.
Serial Investigation was reviewed as the closest pseudo-concurrency label but rejected because the broad investigation never completed as a separate first phase.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; only the independently evidenced fan-out budget episode satisfied the paired retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No downstream timeout, missing artifact, unjoined result, or monitoring symptom was split into a second retained label because those consequences share the same fan-out allocation episode.
